answer.reason: The verses tell of Eli's meeting with Hannah, the judgment announced on his house, and his death at the news of the ark.

clauses.english: told Hannah to go in peace and asked God to grant her petition
clauses.quote: Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition

clauses.english: was told the LORD would judge his house because he did not restrain his sons
clauses.quote: because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not

clauses.english: fell backward from his seat and died on hearing the ark was taken
clauses.quote: he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate

doubts: 1SA 14:3 and 1KI 2:27 only mention Eli's house and were left out.
